issue.title: CI import-recording test: forbid post-provider first imports and enforce preload_post_gate_modules

task_type_fields.proposal: Add a CI test that records every module a runner imports during a representative run and fails if any sase module is first imported after the provider turn starts, turning preload_post_gate_modules into a test-enforced invariant (proposed by sase-1j6.9, epic sase-1j6).
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic sase-1j6 recovers update-skew deaths after the fact and only relaunches pre-provider deaths; preventing post-provider first imports is a separate prevention effort the plan explicitly deferred as follow-up P1.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by sase-1j6.9 (land phase of epic sase-1j6, follow-up P1): update-skew deaths after the model turn come from modules first imported post-provider; a test-enforced invariant would shrink that window.
